does: Pours a liquid or a loose sauce onto food laid in a dish, slowly and from the side, so that it settles into the gaps without washing off the top.

intro.what: Pouring over adds liquid to arranged food gently from the side of its dish.
intro.why: It teaches you to fill gaps without dislodging seasoning, toppings or the arrangement.

how: Lay the food out in the dish first, in the way it is to be served.
Pour from low down near the rim, in a thin steady stream, and not straight onto the middle.
Stop when the liquid has reached the level the dish asks for. Leave the top of the food showing if it is to brown.
Tap the dish gently so that the liquid settles into every gap.

cues.text: The liquid stands at one level all round, and the tops of the pieces show above it.

mistakes.mistake: Pouring from high up, which splashes and washes off the seasoning or the topping.
mistakes.fix: Pour low, from the side, in a thin stream.

mistakes.mistake: Filling the dish to the brim, so that it spills in the oven.
mistakes.fix: Leave a gap below the rim.

quiz.question: Why pour near the side rather than onto the middle?
choices: To let liquid settle without washing off the top.
To push the topping away from the centre.
To leave the gaps beneath the food completely dry.
quiz.because: A gentle side stream reaches the gaps with less force against the exposed surface.

quiz.question: What helps liquid settle into the gaps after pouring?
choices: Shake the dish hard enough to move the pieces.
Press the topping down into the liquid.
quiz.because: Gentle tapping settles the liquid without dismantling the arrangement.

quiz.question: Which appearance suits a dish whose tops should brown?
choices: All tops submerged beneath a full dish.
An even liquid level with the tops still exposed.
quiz.because: Exposed tops can brown while liquid surrounds the lower parts.

quiz.question: Pouring washed the topping off. What would you change next time?
choices: Pour from low near the rim in a thin stream.
Pour faster from higher above the centre.
Direct the stream onto the topping’s highest point.
quiz.because: Reducing the height and force of the stream protects the surface arrangement.

comes_after.why: The food is laid out in the dish first, and the liquid goes over it last.
